summary: Full regression for Receiving Wallets + Vendors CRUD, Recharges gateway-auto-detect & Manual rejection, Expenses payment-method-first flow with ledger auto-debit, and core regression (login, customers, recharges list, invoice PDF). All 14 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend Settings/Recharges/Expenses UI verified via Playwright: testids present, modals open, gateway dropdown excludes Manual and is ordered before coin, OFF_CHAIN network present, matched-wallet-hint shows the seeded Binance BTC address, Bank method shows Wio Bank dropdown, BinancePay method shows Source Wallet dropdown, AED Rate field removed.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.controller.ts looks clean; bad-gateway rejection and missing-field validation both return 400 as expected.

recharges.service.ts: detectGatewayFromAddress() correctly maps Binance BTC seed → 'Binance'. Manual gateway is rejected at create() with 400. nextCode() now uses MAX which removes the count-based race.

expenses.service.ts correctly inserts negative ledger row in BINANCE (USDT) for BinancePay + source_wallet=BINANCE, and in WIO_BANK (AED) for Bank + bank_name='Wio Bank'. Both rows are linked via linked_expense_id.

Frontend Settings page exposes data-testid for all CRUD elements (receiving-wallets-card, vendors-card, wallet-form-submit, vendor-form-submit). Recharges form orders gateway before coin in DOM; networks list contains OFF_CHAIN; matched-wallet-hint shows seeded address text. Expenses form has Payment Method as first field; Bank shows Wio Bank dropdown; BinancePay shows source wallet dropdown.

Note: the field labelled 'Bank Reference / Receipt #' (data-testid exp-form-bank-ref) inside the Bank/Card branch binds to form.tx_hash — i.e. it is the per-method TX/receipt identifier, not the deleted standalone field. This matches the spec; flag only if the product owner wants a different label.
Wallet ledger endpoint returns { rows: [...] } (not items) — confirmed by test; consistent across BINANCE and WIO_BANK ledgers.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up TEST_-prefixed vendors and receiving-wallets; two BinancePay/Bank expenses are persisted (intentional — they verify ledger writes and remain as audit data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_settings_recharges_expenses.py covers receiving-wallets CRUD, vendors CRUD, recharge gateway auto-detect & Manual rejection, expense → BINANCE/WIO_BANK ledger writes, and light regression (customers list, wallets overview, invoice PDF). Ledger endpoint returns rows under the 'rows' key. The matched-wallet-hint testid on Recharges is verified to display the seeded Binance address. Frontend Login requires checking the T&C checkbox (data-testid='login-terms-checkbox') before clicking Submit.
